sentences.en: The management has agreed to have talks with the workers.
sentences.zh: 管理层同意与工人进行会谈。

sentences.en: Management tried to appease labor by offering them a bonus.
sentences.zh: 管理层试图通过提供奖金来安抚劳工。

sentences.en: Management will have all employees vote at the upcoming meeting.
sentences.zh: 在即将召开的会议上，管理层会让所有员工投票。

senses.zh: (企业等的)管理，经营 - 管理人员，管理部门；资方 - 与人交往的技巧，手腕
